npm 12 defaults `allow-git` to `none`. When a workflow upgrades npm, pi-action fails to install git specs such as `github:cv/pit#v0.37.0` with `EALLOWGIT` (see cv/pit#384).

## Changes
- `npm install` for `extensions` (and skill packages) now gets `--allow-git=root`. npm installs the git specs of the input, but not git dependencies of those packages. npm 11, the version on the runners, already supports the flag; its default is `all`.
- If the environment sets `npm_config_allow_git` (any case), pi-action leaves the flag out, so the user's setting wins.
- `docs/extensions.md` describes this under Installation.

Checked: `npm run check` passes. The extension tests also pass with npm 12.2.2 on `PATH`. With npm 12 and `--allow-git=root`, `npm install github:cv/pit#v0.37.0` succeeds; without it, npm refuses."
